item.title: Synchronize Resource Files to Code Repository
item.description: This section describes how to synchronize resource files in a project to a code repository. After synchronization, you can manage the project’s resource files in the code repository. Prerequisites The DevOps extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. A workspace, a DevOps project, and a user (for example, project-regular) have been created. The user has been invited to the DevOps project and granted the operator role.

item.title: View and Download Resource Files
item.description: This section describes how to view Kubernetes resources in a project through a directory tree format. Prerequisites The DevOps extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. A workspace, a DevOps project, and a user (e.g., project-regular) have been created. The user has been invited to the DevOps project and granted the operator role. Please refer to Invite a User to a DevOps Project.
